images.shows: P4 (Stamford): body of the letter including 'block A' (djvu OCR 15529-15551), the OCR-column-disordered numeral passage. Full page at 1600px width.
Native-resolution crop of P4 block A (printed lines 44-61), used to confirm every digit; see NOTES.md s.18.
P9 (Blake to the protector, 4 July 1655): letter opens at bottom of this page, interlinear cipher begins (image_line 45-50).
P9 continued: the rest of the interlinear cipher (image_line 1-6) and the clear-prose resumption (image_line 7). This is the page the djvu OCR fragmented into single-letter mini-lines.
P10 (Blake to the protector, 6 July 1655), whole letter and its interlinear cipher (image_line 4-15) on one page.
Native-resolution crop of P10 image_line 7-12, used to confirm the ambiguous '96' token (misread as 'o6' at 1600px) and the short 'e t u r e t h e' gloss.

P14 (Protector to Blake and Mountagu, 9 June 1656): the Lockhart letter (not transcribed, out of scope, flagged in NOTES.md s.18) and the start of the Blake/Mountagu letter with its interlinear cipher (image_line 44-65).
P14 continued: the rest of the interlinear cipher (image_line 1-21), its end at image_line 22, and the council-attendance signature block (no cipher).
